themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Surge
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked to 10 this week, up 371% from the 8-week baseline average of 2.1 weekly complaints, suggesting either a sudden increase in unlicensed vendors or a coordinated enforcement crackdown that residents are reporting.
evidence: 10 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.3)
371% spike in one week indicates acute, not gradual, change
Suggests either new vendor activity or response to enforcement action
reporting_angles: Has DOHMH or DOC ramped up enforcement on unlicensed food vendors on the Upper East Side?
Are residents reporting a visible increase in cart activity, or are they reporting violations of existing vendors?

themes_detail.label: Traffic Complaint Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints jumped to 5 this week, up 344% from the 8-week baseline of 1.1 weekly complaints, representing the sharpest acceleration in traffic-related issues reported to 311 in recent months.
evidence: 5 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.96)
344% spike is statistically significant and concentrated in current week only
Suggests triggered event: construction, street closure, or new congestion pattern
reporting_angles: Is there active street work, a new construction zone, or transit service disruption on the UES this week?
Are residents reporting gridlock at specific intersections, or is it system-wide congestion?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Parking Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Illegal parking complaints climbed to 231 last week, up 78% from the 8-week average of 129.6 weekly complaints, maintaining the highest absolute complaint volume in the district and now accelerating week-over-week.
evidence: 231 illegal parking complaints last week vs 129.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.57)
Sustained as top complaint category by volume (1,918 over 90 days) with recent acceleration
78% spike suggests either increased violation activity or heightened resident frustration
reporting_angles: Has DOT parking enforcement changed its ticketing patterns or intensity on the UES recently?
Are new residential buildings or commercial developments creating parking displacement in specific neighborhoods?

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dog Emergency
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints exploded to 4 complaints two weeks ago from a baseline of 0.4 weekly complaints (up 967%), representing the most statistically extreme spike in the dataset and a potential public safety concern.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.49, highest in dataset)
967% spike is the most severe statistical anomaly reported
Concentrated event suggests specific location, owner(s), or triggering incident
reporting_angles: Are there specific parks or blocks where unleashed dogs are creating a hazard? Interview residents and NYPD.
Has there been a change in dog park rules, hours, or enforcement that may have triggered this cluster?

themes_detail.label: Building/Use Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building and use complaints spiked to 9 last week, up 324% from the 8-week baseline of 2.1 weekly complaints, potentially signaling new illegal conversions, unpermitted occupancies, or enforcement action on existing violations.
evidence: 9 building/use complaints last week vs 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.42)
324% spike mirrors scale of unleashed dog anomaly, suggesting genuine change in conditions
DOB data shows 1,823 alteration permits filed in last 90 days; may overlap with unreported violations
reporting_angles: Which blocks are seeing the most building violations? Are these new conversions (e.g., short-term rentals, subdivisions)?
Cross-reference 311 spike with DOB permit data to identify patterns of illegal work or unpermitted occupancies.
